fixes.key: %@ hadn't arrived from the cloud after %lld seconds

english.one: %@ hadn't arrived from the cloud after %lld second
english.other: %@ hadn't arrived from the cloud after %lld seconds

before.other: %@ 在 %lld 秒後仍未從雲端送達

after.other: %@ 在 %lld 秒後仍未從雲端下載完成

fixes.why: natural: a file is downloaded from the cloud, not delivered (送達) like a parcel

fixes.key: %@ has no place saved.
fixes.english: %@ has no place saved.
fixes.before: %@ 沒有儲存的位置。
fixes.after: %@ 沒有已儲存的閱讀位置。
fixes.why: meaning: 儲存的位置 reads as a storage location; the place is the reading position

fixes.key: %@ hasn't arrived on this Mac yet. %@ may still be syncing it.
fixes.english: %1$@ hasn't arrived on this Mac yet. %2$@ may still be syncing it.
fixes.before: %1$@ 尚未抵達這部 Mac。%2$@ 可能仍在同步。
fixes.after: %1$@ 尚未下載到這部 Mac 上。%2$@ 可能仍在同步。
fixes.why: natural: a file is downloaded or synced to the Mac; 抵達 is said of travellers and parcels

fixes.key: %@ is filed %@ in %@ and %@ in %@.
fixes.english: %1$@ is filed %2$@ in %3$@ and %4$@ in %5$@.
fixes.why: grammar: %2$@ and %4$@ already begin with 在 (在書庫最上層, 在檔案夾「…」中), so 歸檔於 在… doubled the preposition

fixes.key: %lld episodes
fixes.why: grammar: a counted noun needs its measure word (個), as every other count here has

fixes.key: %lld of %@, %lld percent
fixes.english: %1$lld of %2$@, %3$lld percent
fixes.before: 已完成 %1$lld，共 %2$@，百分之 %3$lld
fixes.after: 已完成 %1$lld 個，共 %2$@，百分之 %3$lld
fixes.why: grammar: 已完成 3 left the count without its measure word

fixes.key: %lld of %@, %lld%%
fixes.before: 已完成 %1$lld，共 %2$@，%3$lld%%
fixes.after: 已完成 %1$lld 個，共 %2$@，%3$lld%%
fixes.why: grammar: 已完成 3 left the count without its measure word

fixes.key: %lld/%lld
fixes.english: %1$lld/%2$lld
fixes.before: %1$lld／%2$lld
fixes.after: %1$lld/%2$lld
fixes.why: punctuation: between Arabic numerals the slash stays half-width, as Apple writes 3/10; the full-width ／ is another braille cell

fixes.key: Added %@, %lld of %lld.
fixes.english: Added %1$@, %2$lld of %3$lld.
fixes.before: 加入日期 %1$@，第 %2$lld 個，共 %3$lld 個。
fixes.after: 已加入 %1$@，第 %2$lld 個，共 %3$lld 個。
fixes.why: meaning: the announcement says a view was added; 加入日期 means the date added

fixes.key: An edit of its text is kept beside the new reading, as a copy in the book's package.
fixes.english: An edit of its text is kept beside the new reading, as a copy in the book's package.
fixes.before: 對其文字所做的編輯，會以副本形式保留在書籍的套件中，與新的閱讀結果並存。
fixes.after: 對其文字所做的編輯，會以副本形式保留在書籍的套件中，與新的讀取結果並存。
fixes.why: meaning: the new reading is the app reading the file (讀取), not a person reading (閱讀)

fixes.key: Asks first, then gives the library a new identity and opens it.
fixes.english: Asks first, then gives the library a new identity and opens it.
fixes.before: 先詢問，然後為書庫給予新身分並打開書庫。
fixes.after: 先詢問，然後給予書庫新身分並打開書庫。
fixes.why: grammar: 為書庫給予 mixed two constructions; 給予書庫新身分, the verb of the Give a New Identity button

fixes.key: Chapter %@ isn't on this Mac.
fixes.english: Chapter %@ isn't on this Mac.
fixes.before: 章節 %@ 不在這部 Mac 上。
fixes.after: 第 %@ 章不在這部 Mac 上。
fixes.why: natural: a numbered chapter is 第 N 章, as the Compare Libraries strings say; 章節 3 copied Chapter 3

fixes.key: Chapter %@ of %@ isn't downloaded.
fixes.english: Chapter %1$@ of %2$@ isn't downloaded.
fixes.why: natural: a numbered chapter is 第 N 章; 章節 3 copied Chapter 3

fixes.key: Chapter %@, from %@
fixes.english: Chapter %1$@, from %2$@
fixes.why: natural: a numbered chapter is 第 N 章; 章節 3 copied Chapter 3

fixes.key: Choose at least one kind of item for the view to list.
fixes.english: Choose at least one kind of item for the view to list.
fixes.before: 請至少選擇一種項目，讓顯示方式列出。
fixes.after: 請至少選擇一種讓顯示方式列出的項目類型。
fixes.why: natural: the purpose clause dangled after the comma; a kind of item is 項目類型

fixes.key: Conditions about books test books, episodes, and articles; conditions about feeds test feeds. A condition never hides a row it does not test.
fixes.english: Conditions about books test books, episodes, and articles; conditions about feeds test feeds. A condition never hides a row it does not test.
fixes.before: 有關書籍的條件會測試書籍、單集和文章；有關訂閱源的條件會測試訂閱源。條件不會隱藏它沒有測試的列。
fixes.after: 有關書籍的條件會檢查書籍、單集和文章；有關訂閱源的條件會檢查訂閱源。條件不會隱藏它未檢查的列。
fixes.why: natural: 測試 (run a test) is a literal copy of test; a condition checks (檢查) a row

fixes.key: Edit Text stops for this book; choose Edit Text again to edit the new reading.
fixes.english: Edit Text stops for this book; choose Edit Text again to edit the new reading.
fixes.before: 此書的「編輯文字」會停止；請再次選擇「編輯文字」來編輯新的閱讀結果。
fixes.after: 此書的「編輯文字」會停止；請再次選擇「編輯文字」來編輯新的讀取結果。
fixes.why: meaning: the new reading is the text the re-read made (讀取), not a person reading (閱讀)

fixes.key: Failed to rebuild to default
fixes.english: Failed to rebuild to default
fixes.before: 無法重建為預設值
fixes.after: 無法重置為預設位置
fixes.why: meaning: Reset to Default moves the data back to the default location; 預設值 means a default value

fixes.key: Give the library a new identity?
fixes.english: Give the library a new identity?
fixes.before: 要為書庫給予新身分嗎？
fixes.after: 要給予書庫新身分嗎？
fixes.why: grammar: 為書庫給予 mixed two constructions; 給予書庫新身分, as the button says

fixes.key: Go up one folder level
fixes.english: Go up one folder level
fixes.before: 上移一層檔案夾
fixes.after: 前往上層檔案夾
fixes.why: meaning: 上移 is the glossary Move Up, so 上移一層檔案夾 sounded like moving a folder; the button goes to the enclosing folder (Finder: 上層檔案夾)

fixes.key: If %@ arrives from %@ later, %@ may keep two copies of it.
fixes.english: If %1$@ arrives from %2$@ later, %3$@ may keep two copies of it.
fixes.before: 如果之後 %1$@ 從 %2$@ 抵達，%3$@ 可能會保留它的兩個副本。
fixes.after: 如果之後 %1$@ 從 %2$@ 同步過來，%3$@ 可能會保留它的兩個副本。
fixes.why: natural: a file syncs over (同步過來) from a cloud service; 抵達 is said of travellers and parcels

fixes.key: If the file arrives from %@ later, it names the same library.
fixes.english: If the file arrives from %@ later, it names the same library.
fixes.before: 如果之後該檔案從 %@ 抵達，它會指向同一個書庫。
fixes.after: 如果之後該檔案從 %@ 同步過來，它會指向同一個書庫。
fixes.why: natural: a file syncs over (同步過來) from a cloud service; 抵達 is said of travellers and parcels

fixes.key: If the library's own %@ arrives from %@ later, %@ may keep two copies of it, and this Mac and the other would disagree about which library this is.
fixes.english: If the library's own %1$@ arrives from %2$@ later, %3$@ may keep two copies of it, and this Mac and the other would disagree about which library this is.
fixes.before: 如果書庫本身的 %1$@ 之後從 %2$@ 抵達，%3$@ 可能會保留它的兩個副本，而這部 Mac 與另一部對於這是哪個書庫會有不同看法。
fixes.after: 如果書庫本身的 %1$@ 之後從 %2$@ 同步過來，%3$@ 可能會保留它的兩個副本，而這部 Mac 與另一部 Mac 對於這是哪個書庫會有不同看法。
fixes.why: natural: a file syncs over (同步過來) from a cloud service, not arrives (抵達); 另一部 alone lacked its noun

fixes.key: Its text is replaced by the new reading.
fixes.english: Its text is replaced by the new reading.
fixes.before: 其文字會被新的閱讀結果取代。
fixes.after: 其文字會被新的讀取結果取代。
fixes.why: meaning: the new reading is the text the re-read made (讀取), not a person reading (閱讀)

fixes.key: Media-control events that trigger the restart. The last one is consumed, not passed to playback, so it can't start audio.
fixes.english: Media-control events that trigger the restart. The last one is consumed, not passed to playback, so it can't start audio.
fixes.before: 觸發重新啟動的媒體控制事件。最後一個事件會被消耗，不會傳給播放，因此無法啟動音訊。
fixes.after: 觸發重新啟動的媒體控制事件。最後一個事件會被攔截，不會傳給播放功能，因此無法啟動音訊。
fixes.why: natural: an event that is consumed is intercepted (攔截); 消耗 means used up, like fuel

fixes.key: Nothing is copied, and nothing is created in %@.
fixes.english: Nothing is copied, and nothing is created in %@.
fixes.before: 不會複製任何內容，也不會在 %@ 中建立任何內容。
fixes.after: 不會拷貝任何內容，也不會在 %@ 中建立任何內容。
fixes.why: term: copying data is the glossary verb 拷貝, as the question before the move says; 複製 is Apple's Duplicate

fixes.key: Nothing is copied, and the library in %@ stays as it is.
fixes.english: Nothing is copied, and the library in %@ stays as it is.
fixes.before: 不會複製任何內容，位於 %@ 的書庫會維持原樣。
fixes.after: 不會拷貝任何內容，位於 %@ 的書庫會維持原樣。
fixes.why: term: copying data is the glossary verb 拷貝, as the question before the move says; 複製 is Apple's Duplicate

fixes.key: Only the Latest from Each Feed
fixes.english: Only the Latest from Each Feed
fixes.before: 只列出每個訂閱源的最新項目
fixes.after: 每個訂閱源只列出最近打開的項目
fixes.why: meaning: the checkbox keeps the item you opened last (its hint says so); 最新項目 reads as the newest episode published

fixes.key: Open the library without its index?
fixes.english: Open the library without its index?
fixes.before: 要不使用索引打開書庫嗎？
fixes.after: 要在不使用索引的情況下打開書庫嗎？
fixes.why: meaning: 要不使用索引… is heard as 要不 (how about) using the index; the question is whether to open without it

fixes.key: Preparing %@ of %@…
fixes.english: Preparing %1$@ of %2$@…
fixes.after: 正在準備：已完成 %1$@ 本，共 %2$@…
fixes.why: meaning: %1$@ counts the books already prepared; 正在準備 3 本 said three were being prepared

fixes.key: Read “%@” again as %@?
fixes.english: Read “%1$@” again as %2$@?
fixes.before: 要將「%1$@」重新讀取為 %2$@ 嗎？
fixes.why: natural: the encoding or code is the means of the re-read (以 X 讀取); 重新讀取為 X read as turning the book into X

fixes.key: Still comparing: %lld seconds so far. Press Escape to stop.

english.one: Still comparing: %lld second so far. Press Escape to stop.
english.other: Still comparing: %lld seconds so far. Press Escape to stop.

before.other: 仍在比較：目前已 %lld 秒。按 Escape 鍵可停止。

after.other: 仍在比較：已進行 %lld 秒。按 Escape 鍵可停止。

fixes.why: grammar: 目前已 %lld 秒 had no verb; the comparison has run (已進行) that long

fixes.key: Stops moving the library. The library stays where it is, and nothing is changed.
fixes.english: Stops moving the library. The library stays where it is, and nothing is changed.
fixes.before: 停止移動書庫。書庫會維持原處，不會有任何更改。
fixes.after: 停止移動書庫。書庫會留在原處，不會有任何更改。
fixes.why: natural: a place is kept with 留在原處; 維持原處 mixed it with 維持原狀

fixes.key: Take it off the reading list, or clear %@ in the Reading List's options first.
fixes.english: Take it off the reading list, or clear %@ in the Reading List's options first.
fixes.before: 請先將它從閱讀列表中移除，或清除閱讀列表選項中的 %@。
fixes.after: 請先將它從閱讀列表中移除，或在閱讀列表的選項中取消勾選 %@。
fixes.why: meaning: %@ is a checkbox, which is unchecked (取消勾選); 清除 means erase

fixes.key: Text extraction progress: %lld of %lld
fixes.english: Text extraction progress: %1$lld of %2$lld
fixes.before: 文字擷取進度：已完成 %1$lld，共 %2$lld
fixes.after: 文字擷取進度：已完成 %1$lld 本，共 %2$lld 本
fixes.why: grammar: the counts of books lacked their measure word (本)

fixes.key: TextMouth could not move %@ to the current library format.
fixes.english: TextMouth could not move %@ to the current library format.
fixes.before: TextMouth 無法將 %@ 移到目前的書庫格式。
fixes.after: TextMouth 無法將 %@ 移轉到目前的書庫格式。
fixes.why: natural: a book is migrated (移轉, as in Apple's 移轉輔助程式) to the new format; 移到…格式 moved it to a format as to a place

fixes.key: TextMouth could not record the removal in its package, %@.
fixes.english: TextMouth could not record the removal in its package, %@.
fixes.before: TextMouth 無法在其套件中記錄這次移除，%@。
fixes.after: TextMouth 無法在書籍的套件 %@ 中記錄這次移除。
fixes.why: meaning: 其套件 read as TextMouth's own package, and the folder name trailed after a comma; it is the book's package named %@

fixes.key: TextMouth couldn't keep the text you changed in “%@” beside the new reading, so it left the book as it was.
fixes.english: TextMouth couldn't keep the text you changed in “%@” beside the new reading, so it left the book as it was.
fixes.before: TextMouth 無法將你在「%@」中更改的文字與新的閱讀結果一併保留，因此書籍維持原樣。
fixes.after: TextMouth 無法將你在「%@」中更改的文字與新的讀取結果一併保留，因此書籍維持原樣。
fixes.why: meaning: the new reading is the text the re-read made (讀取), not a person reading (閱讀)

fixes.key: TextMouth is getting them now, and the library opens when they arrive.
fixes.english: TextMouth is getting them now, and the library opens when they arrive.
fixes.before: TextMouth 現在正在取得這些檔案，檔案抵達後會打開書庫。
fixes.after: TextMouth 正在取得這些檔案，取得後就會打開書庫。
fixes.why: natural: the files are fetched (取得), as the first clause says; 抵達 is said of travellers and parcels

fixes.key: TextMouth is opening again on another library, so they stay unsaved in this one.
fixes.english: TextMouth is opening again on another library, so they stay unsaved in this one.
fixes.before: TextMouth 正在另一個書庫上重新打開，因此它們在這個書庫中保持未儲存。
fixes.after: TextMouth 正在重新打開並改用另一個書庫，因此這些更改在這個書庫中仍未儲存。
fixes.why: natural: 在另一個書庫上重新打開 copied opening again on; TextMouth reopens and uses the other library; they are the unsaved changes

fixes.key: TextMouth is opening again on another library, so they stay where they are in this one.
fixes.english: TextMouth is opening again on another library, so they stay where they are in this one.
fixes.before: TextMouth 正在另一個書庫上重新打開，因此它們在這個書庫中維持原處。
fixes.after: TextMouth 正在重新打開並改用另一個書庫，因此它們會留在這個書庫中的原處。
fixes.why: natural: 在另一個書庫上重新打開 copied opening again on; TextMouth reopens and uses the other library

fixes.key: TextMouth is switching to another library and opening again on it.
fixes.english: TextMouth is switching to another library and opening again on it.
fixes.before: TextMouth 正在切換到另一個書庫，並在其上重新打開。
fixes.after: TextMouth 正在切換到另一個書庫，並以該書庫重新打開。
fixes.why: natural: 在另一個書庫上重新打開 copied opening again on; TextMouth reopens and uses the other library

fixes.key: TextMouth isn't allowed to make changes in %@.
fixes.english: TextMouth isn't allowed to make changes in %@.
fixes.before: TextMouth 不被允許在 %@ 中做更改。
fixes.after: TextMouth 沒有權限在 %@ 中進行更改。
fixes.why: natural: 不被允許 is a translated passive; Chinese says TextMouth has no permission

fixes.key: TextMouth moved %@ to the current library format, but with a problem:
fixes.english: TextMouth moved %@ to the current library format, but with a problem:
fixes.before: TextMouth 已將 %@ 移到目前的書庫格式，但有一個問題：
fixes.after: TextMouth 已將 %@ 移轉到目前的書庫格式，但有一個問題：
fixes.why: natural: a book is migrated (移轉, as in Apple's 移轉輔助程式) to the new format; 移到…格式 moved it to a format as to a place

fixes.key: TextMouth moved %@ to the current library format, but with problems:
fixes.english: TextMouth moved %@ to the current library format, but with problems:
fixes.before: TextMouth 已將 %@ 移到目前的書庫格式，但有一些問題：
fixes.after: TextMouth 已將 %@ 移轉到目前的書庫格式，但有一些問題：
fixes.why: natural: a book is migrated (移轉, as in Apple's 移轉輔助程式) to the new format; 移到…格式 moved it to a format as to a place

fixes.key: TextMouth will quit and open again to start it.
fixes.english: TextMouth will quit and open again to start it.
fixes.before: TextMouth 會結束並重新打開以開始它。
fixes.after: TextMouth 會結束並重新打開，以開始新書庫。
fixes.why: natural: 以開始它 has no object Chinese can start; it is the new library (開始新書庫, as the button says)

fixes.key: That would put %@ %lld levels deep, but folders nest at most %lld levels.

english.one: That would put %@ %lld level deep, but folders nest at most %lld levels.
english.other: That would put %@ %lld levels deep, but folders nest at most %lld levels.

before.other: 這樣會讓 %@ 深入 %lld 層，但檔案夾最多只能巢狀 %lld 層。

after.other: 這樣會讓 %@ 深入 %lld 層，但檔案夾最多只能有 %lld 層。

fixes.why: natural: 巢狀 as a verb is programmer jargon; folders can have at most N levels

fixes.key: The View pop-up of a Library window offers these views in this order. A new window opens at the first one offered.
fixes.english: The View pop-up of a Library window offers these views in this order. A new window opens at the first one offered.
fixes.before: 書庫視窗的「顯示方式」彈出式選單會依此順序提供這些顯示方式。新視窗會打開在提供的第一個。
fixes.after: 書庫視窗的「顯示方式」彈出式選單會依此順序提供這些顯示方式。新視窗會以第一個提供的顯示方式打開。
fixes.why: natural: 打開在提供的第一個 copied the English word order and left the noun out

fixes.key: The book is kept on this Mac, and is on the reading list, which this Mac keeps downloaded, so its download can't be removed.
fixes.english: The book is kept on this Mac, and is on the reading list, which this Mac keeps downloaded, so its download can't be removed.
fixes.before: 這本書已保留在這部 Mac 上，也在閱讀列表上，而這部 Mac 會保持閱讀列表的下載，因此無法移除它的下載項目。
fixes.after: 這本書已保留在這部 Mac 上，也在閱讀列表上，而這部 Mac 會讓閱讀列表中的書籍保持下載，因此無法移除它的下載項目。
fixes.why: natural: 這部 Mac 會保持閱讀列表的下載 was garbled; the Mac keeps the reading list's books downloaded

fixes.key: The book is on the reading list, which this Mac keeps downloaded, so its download can't be removed.
fixes.english: The book is on the reading list, which this Mac keeps downloaded, so its download can't be removed.
fixes.before: 這本書在閱讀列表上，而這部 Mac 會保持閱讀列表的下載，因此無法移除其下載項目。
fixes.after: 這本書在閱讀列表上，而這部 Mac 會讓閱讀列表中的書籍保持下載，因此無法移除其下載項目。
fixes.why: natural: 這部 Mac 會保持閱讀列表的下載 was garbled; the Mac keeps the reading list's books downloaded

fixes.key: The library already had different content under its package name, %@, so it was stored in a new package, %@, and its original file was kept at %@.
fixes.english: The library already had different content under its package name, %1$@, so it was stored in a new package, %2$@, and its original file was kept at %3$@.
